name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/quartz-og-image
description: Quartz 5 cards for shared links: stock og-image with last-segment tag chips, a configurable icon, and no generation under serve. See README.md and CONTEXT.md.
//exports: Every entry has its type declarations beside it, which build.mjs emits: Quartz's generated plugin index skips a package without dist/index.d.ts, and a TypeScript site imports the types from them. ./package.json is how Quartz reads the manifest (import.meta.resolve).
//peerDependencies: The host Quartz's own copies, never bundled or installed here. Stock og-image is the plugin this one wraps; every stock Quartz carries it, and @quartz-community/* is a shared scope the loader expects to find beside a plugin, never inside it.
//devDependencies: Inlined into dist by build.mjs, or the build tool itself: stock og-image bundles reading-time rather than exporting it, and the card counts minutes the same way. esbuild is here so the build never borrows the host's toolchain (ADR-0005). @chaoticgoodcomputing/declarations writes the .d.ts beside each entry (build.mjs), and is a `workspace:*` spec like every library of ours, which `pnpm publish` rewrites to the published version (ADR-0005).
